mainText: Good morning. Futures are roughly flat this morning. The S and P 500 is up about two tenths of a percent, the Dow is up about a tenth of a percent, and the Nasdaq is about flat. The ten year Treasury yield is about 5.12 percent, up about two basis points. Biggest premarket movers: Modine up 25 to 30 percent on Samsung buyout talks. Cerebras up 17 to 18 percent after raising its forecast. Nvidia up about 2 percent, rebounding. Microsoft down about 2 percent on an outage. Cisco up about 4 percent on an earnings beat.
